notes: Wave 1 — native messaging surface parity: conversation list (unread/timestamps/drafts/archive/mute/mark-unread/pin), chat room with cursor pagination + optimistic sends + sent/seen ticks + day separators, full realtime (Socket.IO reconnect/re-join, typing, presence, read receipts, unread updates), message actions (reply/react/edit/delete/pin/save/forward/info), threads with correct parentId behavior (one-level rule enforced server-side), drafts with server mirror, offline outbox (FIFO 50, retry/backoff, temp→server reconciliation), search (global + in-room + jump-to-message), media messaging (image/file upload base64 → /api/uploads, captions, AsyncImage/Coil rendering, lightbox + QuickLook). Android Room v5 / iOS GRDB v3 full-fidelity caches. Installable APK versionCode 11.
